observation_summary: The methods getDomainAxisIndex and getRangeAxisIndex in CategoryPlot were failing to handle null arguments, leading to unexpected behavior or potential errors when null was passed.
reasoning_summary: The fix adds explicit null checks at the beginning of the methods getDomainAxisIndex and getRangeAxisIndex, throwing an IllegalArgumentException if the input axis is null. This is a classic example of adding missing validation for input parameters, which falls directly under the 'Checking' category in ODC.
evidence_used: The fix_diff_oracle shows the addition of 'if (axis == null) { throw new IllegalArgumentException(...); }' to both getDomainAxisIndex and getRangeAxisIndex methods.
The failing tests in CategoryPlotTests were testing the behavior of these methods when passed a null argument, expecting an exception.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: The fix does not change the underlying algorithm or logic of the methods; it only adds a guard clause to validate input parameters.
